gloss: hearing something for the first time; news to me

definitions.gloss: hearing something for the first time; news to someone
definitions.explanation: The experience of hearing a piece of information for the very first time. Used as a response to express that something is new and surprising to the listener.

examples.japanese: それは{初耳|はつみみ}だ。
{彼|かれ}が{転職|てんしょく}したなんて{初耳|はつみみ}だよ。
examples.english: I had no idea he changed jobs — that's the first I've heard of it.

examples.japanese: そんな{規則|きそく}があるとは{初耳|はつみみ}で、{驚|おどろ}いてしまった。
examples.english: I was surprised — I had never heard that such a rule existed.

notes:
A compound of {初|はつ} (first) and {耳|みみ} (ear). Literally 'first ear' — the first time one's ears encounter the information.

Almost always used in the pattern ～は{初耳|はつみみ}だ. Very natural in conversation as a surprised response to unexpected news.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- それは{初耳|はつみみ}だ (That's news to me)
- ～なんて{初耳|はつみみ}だ (I had no idea that...)
- {初耳|はつみみ}の{話|はなし} (a story one hasn't heard before)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {初|はじ}めて{聞|き}いた is a more literal way to say 'I heard it for the first time'
- {初耳|はつみみ} is more concise and conversational
